attachments.insertion_landmark: distal phalanx of the great toe

actions: extends the great toe, dorsiflexes ankle

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Lies between tibialis anterior and extensor digitorum longus in the anterior compartment; its tendon is a palpable landmark on the dorsum of the foot used to locate the dorsalis pedis pulse.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
